description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCalendarProvider' which serves as a base for implementing calendar provider integrations within SuiteCRM. It includes method signatures for testing connections, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting calendar events, and manages dependencies like event factories and configuration.

classes.name: AbstractCalendarProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for calendar provider implementations, including methods for connection testing, event management, and configuration handling.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Abstract method to test the calendar connection, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve events based on a query.

methods.name: createEventFromSource
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event from a source event and sync time.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates an event in the target system.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the actual creation of an event.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve an event by target ID.

methods.name: updateEventFromSource
methods.description: Updates an event in the target system from a source event.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an event in the target system.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the actual event update.

methods.name: updateSourceEvent
methods.description: Updates the source event with the linked target event ID.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event in the target system.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the actual event deletion.

methods.name: getExternalCalendarName
methods.description: Retrieves the external calendar name from configuration.
